name: Oriel
note: How Oriel puts pieces together, from a level-1 mark up to the window. Values come only from tokens.json; the canvas layout.css is generated from this file, and the screens follow it.
rules: Alignment makes the structure. A row's text, the list's text and the reading column each start on one line down the whole screen; there are no boxes or borders to fake that order.
A row of fixed height centers everything on its middle line. A block of several lines aligns to its top.
An icon or a source tile sits in a square of its own size token, so the text after it starts at the same x in every row whether the picture loaded or not.
Every size is one of three: hug the content, fill the parent, or a size token.
Space lives on the layout only (gap and padding). A component carries no margin of its own.
Trailing content (a count, a time, a star) is pushed to the end by a spacer, never by a margin.
Chinese text is never letter-spaced; the space between Chinese and Latin text comes from the typesetting pass, not from typed spaces (spec: type).
Fine tuning uses only the utility classes below; a style never writes a raw number.

patterns.name: pair
patterns.usage: A mark and its words: an icon and a label in a button, a tile and a source name, a health mark and its phrase.

patterns.name: row
patterns.usage: One item per line: a pane row, a menu item, a dense entry, a settings line. Pick the height token; trailing items after a spacer.

patterns.name: controls
patterns.usage: Controls side by side: a toolbar's right side, a dialog's buttons, the reader's actions.

patterns.name: control
patterns.usage: The shape of a button and of a field's inner row.

patterns.name: track
patterns.usage: The groove a segmented control and a switch run in.

patterns.name: bar
patterns.usage: The toolbar over the list and over the reader, level with the traffic lights.

patterns.name: stack-tight
patterns.usage: Rows of one list: pane rows, menu items.

patterns.name: stack
patterns.usage: A title over its meta line; a label over its field.

patterns.name: stack-block
patterns.usage: The parts of a card or a settings group.

patterns.name: stack-section
patterns.usage: Sections of a page: settings groups, the reader's header, summary and prose.

patterns.name: stack-page
patterns.usage: The largest step: between a page title and its content, between the parts of a long settings page.

patterns.name: inset-card
patterns.usage: Inside a card on surface: the AI summary, a note, an empty state's plate.

patterns.name: column
patterns.usage: The reading column: centered in the space beside the pane, at most `column` wide.

patterns.name: center
patterns.usage: One thing in the middle of its space: an empty state, a spinner while a page loads.

patterns.name: spacer
patterns.usage: Takes what is left, pushing what follows to the end.

utilities.note: Utility classes, values from tokens only: l-p / l-px / l-py / l-pt / l-pr / l-pb / l-pl plus a spacing name (l-px-3 is space-3 left and right); l-gap- plus a spacing name; l-h / l-w / l-sq (width and height) / l-min-h plus a size name (l-sq-tile-m, l-h-row). Without a value: l-p-0, l-gap-0, l-fill, l-hug, l-h-full, l-grow, l-none, l-items-start / center / end / stretch, l-wrap.
